thread:
santiago: Heads-up — seeing partial nvme read errors on gnode-asia-101 and a spike in GPU attach failures since ~02:10 UTC. Attach rate down ~18%.
ops-bot: ALERT: nvme-read-errors detected on fleet-asia nodes (count=37) — autosnooze=10m — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/storage-io
Dina: I saw the same in the attach dashboard, batch jobs are timing out and falling back to remote volumes. Cost hit already showing in the daily burn preview. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Kyle: grabbing dmesg from one of the affected nodes, pasted: ```
[ 1023.456789] nvme0: I/O 12345 QID 4 timeout, aborting
[ 1023.456795] nvme0: read error status: 0x2 (CRC)
[ 1023.456800] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 23456789
```
Anika: Is this correlated with the janitor/ephemeral-scrub windows? We recently bumped scrub concurrency in ap-southeast to 6 last week. Maybe thermal/wear coupling.
Kyle: smartctl and nvme-cli snippet (truncated): ```
# nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1
critical_warning: 0x04
temperature: 65 C
data_units_read: 1,234,567
warning_temp_time: 12
# nvme error-log /dev/nvme0
error_count: 22
submission_queue_timeout: 18
```
Dina: If scrub is thrashing hot stripes it could create transient high tail latency which the attach path treats as read failures. We should avoid disabling scrub globally. Suggest: throttle scrub on gnode-asia-1* temporarily and reroute new batch attaches to eu-west until we have a fix.
Anika: Agreed. Propose a quick mitigation: 1) set scrub_concurrency=2 for the asia pool, 2) mark gnode-asia-101..110 as drain-preferred for new GPU jobs, 3) turn on aggressive retry in attach path for 10m. Anyone object?
Dina: +1, do we have a config toggle for concurrency without rolling agents? ops-bot: CONFIG-UPDATE: scrub_concurrency is patchable via fleet-config API: POST /api/v1/fleet-config {"scrub_concurrency":2} — limited to ops role.
Kyle: I'll run a targeted smartctl scan on gnode-asia-101..105 and kick off a background scrub-adjust. Also creating a diagnostic ticket: CHG-3321.
janitor-bot: NOTE: ephemeral-cleaner will reduce aggressive deletes for asia region for 30m per config change CHG-3321.
Dina: Also, cost note — if we start routing to remote volumes, informal estimate is +12% token cost for batch runs for the next 24h. Flagging product for tradeoff. @anika please ping infra-costs channel.
Anika: pinged infra-costs, will loop in finance. I'll implement the scrub throttle and update the runbook with the temporary mitigation steps.
ops-bot: ACTION_ASSIGNED: oncall -> santiago (ticket CHG-3321) — please update status every 30m.
Santiago: on it, will post updates. First mitigation applied: scrub_concurrency=2 to asia-ephemeral at 02:22 UTC.
